question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle B=\angle C\). What can be concluded?
solution: Sides opposite equal angles are equal. The sides opposite \(\angle B\) and \(\angle C\) are \(AC\) and \(AB\), respectively, so \(AB=AC\).
